methods: Classify only positively proved same-entity documented exceptions or district-item errors on distinct Bangladesh city settlements. P31/P131 use non-deprecated, unended best-rank statements. A distinct P36 seat must fit the city label, settlement class and every point within 10 km. Population equal to the district count or over three times the seat count is a conservative hold signal, never proof of identity. Record full pinned row, state, county link, type, level, points, population, native names and official codes. Uncertain identities, legacy administrative city rows, incomplete evidence and special territories stay held. No replacement item is asserted; no other field is changed.
